method: Two complete fresh-process runs, each 3 seeds x 1000 training steps, compared recursively after excluding only created_at_utc. Tokenizer and seed-results JSONL bytes also compared exactly. Source hashes and corpus hash checked against the working tree.
limitation: Reproduction verified in this environment, not a cross-device/version guarantee. Reproduction results file has a different hash because its timestamp differs. The measured result file and train-only tokenizer are published; model weights are not.
